title: Wave-row crank handle
section: Second round: stage machinery, footlights and the HUD
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
A stage-machinery crank seen square-on, as a stagehand turns it from the wing: a round brass hub boss with a square axle hole at the exact centre of the image, a flat black iron crank arm running from the hub straight out to the right, and a turned dark-wood handle knob standing at the end of the arm, worn pale where hands grip it. The hub must sit exactly at the image centre, as the game spins the whole piece around it. Match the brass of touch-stick-knob and the gold of the proscenium. Flat painted toy-theatre cut-out seen square-on, gouache on card with a faint pale cut edge; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey line and tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 laid slightly out of register; no cast shadow; no lettering; isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable).
Requested final aspect ratio 200:200. Real transparent alpha outside the isolated art.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark. Allocate transparent padding to LEFT so the axle hole sits at exactly 50% canvas width and height, with arm pointing right. Do not centre the whole silhouette.
